title: Reviewer proportionality: REVISE only for real gate/acceptance failures (D-037)
objective: Add a proportionality/blocking-threshold rule to the supervisor reviewer instruction (tools/agent_supervisor/prompts/codex_review.md) so the Codex/Astra reviewer reserves REVISE (which forces a full worker redo) for genuine violations of the current stage's acceptance criteria or a real gate (correctness, safety, contract/back-compat, failing tests, or the repo's hard CI rules: modularity size, security, dependency-security). Minor non-blocking issues become a recorded non-blocking advisory + COMPLETE for the stage, not a redo; each REVISE must name which acceptance criterion or gate it blocks on. Add a reviewer-decision test proving a minor non-blocker maps to COMPLETE-with-advisory and a real gate failure maps to REVISE. Weaken NO real gate; HALT_UNSAFE/STOP_FOR_OWNER/read-only discipline unchanged; the consecutive-revision breaker stays as the backstop. Freeze-rule task; recert before the running controller uses it.
business_reason: D-037: prevent the reviewer from looping the worker on minimum fixes without weakening real gates.
outputs: tools/agent_supervisor/prompts/codex_review.md (proportionality/blocking-threshold rule: REVISE only for a named acceptance-criterion or gate failure; minor non-blockers -> COMPLETE + recorded advisory; each REVISE names the gate/criterion it blocks on)

tools/test_agent_supervisor_reviewer.py (reviewer-decision tests: a minor non-blocker maps to COMPLETE-with-advisory; a real gate failure maps to REVISE; the per-REVISE named-gate requirement is present)
forbidden_paths: any change that weakens a real gate (correctness/safety/contract/tests/modularity/security/dependency-security)
HALT_UNSAFE / STOP_FOR_OWNER semantics, read-only reviewer discipline, the consecutive-revision breaker
any product/runtime code (services/**, apps/**, packages/**), other tasks' paths
live edits to the running controller install without recertification
notes: The distinguisher is OBJECTIVE, not the model's gut feeling: for each finding the reviewer must name the specific automated gate (failing test, modularity size, security, dependency-security) or the specific written acceptance criterion it violates; if it can name one -> REVISE (full deep analysis unchanged), if it cannot -> non-blocking advisory + COMPLETE. Real blockers still get full scrutiny; only the disposition of gate-free nits changes.
CHECKPOINT ENVELOPE CONTRACT (DL-2): starting_sha/current_sha are FULL 40-hex or empty; documented commands run via the Bash tool VERBATIM (no wrappers).
FREEZE-RULE task: cite the qualifying evidence in packet + commit; recertify before the running controller uses the new prompt.
